evidence: The paper does not report impurity-based feature importance. Instead, it focuses on predictive performance: "The SVM had an area under the receiver-operator curve of 0.94 and an area under precision-recall curve of 0.96... The RF had an area under the receiver-operator curve of 0.84 and an area under precision-recall curve of 0.87." Conclusions rest on classification accuracy, out-of-bag voting consensus across trees, unsupervised k-means clustering of phenotypes, and t-tests on individual features. Multiple classifiers (RF and SVM) are tested for cross-validation.
